prompt: Give me the directions from Munich's Airport to its city center
response: To get from Munich Airport to the city center, you can take the S1 train, which runs every 10 minutes, and get off at Munich Hauptbahnhof (main station). The journey takes about 40 minutes. From there, you can take any S-Bahn or U-Bahn to reach your final destination. Alternatively, you can take a taxi, which will take around 20 minutes and cost around €40.
